integrity: The period propagator is multiplied explicitly, its unit-eigenvalue determinant is factored exactly, and Perron monotonicity identifies the unique spectral crossing. The aggregate comparison and three-node minimality are proved symbolically and replayed by an exact-rational verifier.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the deterministic individual-based discrete-time SIS linearization on a period-two network with exactly one active edge per snapshot. It is not an exact finite-population stochastic extinction threshold. If the formal critical transmission probability exceeds one, the disease-free linearization remains stable over the entire physical probability interval.
title: Two alternating contacts have an exact three-node discrete-time epidemic penalty
